¿Quiénes somos? 




At NUBA, we believe travel is an art.

The Art of Travel starts with extraordinary people.

title: Creator Incubation Project Intern (TikTok Shop - Mexico Operation) - 2026 Start (BS/MS)
skills: Assist in empowering and incubating high-potential e-commerce creators by providing daily support, guidance, and encouragement on content production techniques.
Actively communicate and build strong, trust-based relationships with creators and agency hosts, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to achieve their sales goals.
Support the team in matching curated product assortments with the right creators, helping to brainstorm and co-create engaging e-commerce content (short videos & livestreams).
Help organize and facilitate training sessions for livestream hosts, assisting them in understanding livestreaming tools, refining on-camera scripts, and improving viewer interaction.
Assist in tracking and analyzing post-livestream data. Help translate these data insights into easy-to-understand, actionable advice that creators can use to optimize their future sessions.
Guide creators to maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines, fostering a healthy e-commerce ecosystem.
Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
Strong skills in interpersonal and communication; you are a "people person" who genuinely enjoys interacting, listening, and building rapport with diverse individuals.
Proactive fast-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.
Proven skills in analytical with a willingness to learn how to use data to formulate actionable strategies.
Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
Experience in TikTok platform, short-form video trends, and the livestreaming e-commerce ecosystem.
description:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the Mexico operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:


 Assist in empowering and incubating high-potential e-commerce creators by providing daily support, guidance, and encouragement on content production techniques.
 Actively communicate and build strong, trust-based relationships with creators and agency hosts, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to achieve their sales goals.
 Support the team in matching curated product assortments with the right creators, helping to brainstorm and co-create engaging e-commerce content (short videos & livestreams).
 Help organize and facilitate training sessions for livestream hosts, assisting them in understanding livestreaming tools, refining on-camera scripts, and improving viewer interaction.
 Assist in tracking and analyzing post-livestream data. Help translate these data insights into easy-to-understand, actionable advice that creators can use to optimize their future sessions.
 Guide creators to maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines, fostering a healthy e-commerce ecosystem.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Strong skills in interpersonal and communication; you are a "people person" who genuinely enjoys interacting, listening, and building rapport with diverse individuals.
 Proactive fast-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.
 Proven skills in analytical with a willingness to learn how to use data to formulate actionable strategies.


Preferred Qualifications


 Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
 Experience in TikTok platform, short-form video trends, and the livestreaming e-commerce ecosystem.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok E-commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

title: Growth Marketing Coordinator (Lifecycle & Outbound)
description:
About Us

MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America and Africa to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development projects.

Our mission

is to build a worldwide Movement empowering the poor in their fight for equal access to healthcare, education, and a safe home.

Our vision

is a world free from the constraints of poverty. MEDLIFE works with students from around the world in order to broaden their perspectives and better equip them to advocate for social justice.

Our ideal Growth Marketing Coordinator (Lifecycle & Outbound)

We're looking for a growth marketer who knows how to start new relationships and how to deepen existing ones. You have run cold email and outbound campaigns at real scale, and you have built lifecycle journeys that turned first-time customers into repeat ones. You value proof over activity: you can speak to the numbers behind your work, including volumes, reply rates, retention, and what you changed after a test. As we continue growing, we'd love for you to be part of the MEDLIFE Movement.

About The Role

You will build and own MEDLIFE's email- and CRM-driven growth engine across the full participant journey. On the acquisition side, you will identify and reach high-potential U.S. college students through outbound and cold email, generating qualified conversations that grow MEDLIFE's Student Leadership Teams and chapter network. On the retention side, you will own the journey after the first conversion, building nurture, repurchase, and reactivation journeys in HubSpot that turn participants into repeat travelers, chapter leaders, and lifelong alumni advocates.

This is an individual contributor position with end-to-end ownership of outbound and lifecycle outcomes, and a clear path to a Lead role as the function grows. You will report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with the Expansion, Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, and Data Solutions teams.

What will your day-to-day look like at MEDLIFE?

Identify universities, student organizations, and individual students most likely to become MEDLIFE leaders, and build targeted prospect lists and ICPs.

Source, verify, and maintain clean prospect data in HubSpot, using enrichment tools and AI.

Manage sending infrastructure and deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, sending volume), protecting MEDLIFE's sender reputation.

Write and test cold email sequences for different student personas, in line with CAN-SPAM and other applicable compliance practices.

Map the full participant journey, from first contact through participation, chapter leadership, graduation, and alumni advocacy.

Build segmented nurture, repurchase, and reactivation journeys in HubSpot based on behavior, lifecycle stage, program history, and inactivity.

Run multichannel campaigns (email, SMS/WhatsApp, myMEDLIFE, social retargeting) focused on relevant next actions, not message volume.

Partner with Expansion, Sales, and Customer Success on clear handoffs between automated outreach and human follow-up.

Track conversion, deliverability, reactivation, LTV, and revenue influenced, and keep improving targeting, segmentation, and messaging.

What will you bring?

Minimum 4 years of combined growth marketing experience, including at least 2 years in lifecycle, retention, or CRM marketing and at least 2 years running cold email or outbound campaigns (or equivalent hands-on experience across both), with a focus on U.S. and/or Canadian audiences.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Data/Growth Analytics, or a related field; hands-on experience takes precedence over formal credentials.

Proven ownership of retention, repurchase, reactivation, or LTV outcomes through segmented, multi-stage journeys.

Cold email at meaningful scale (not small-batch or newsletter-level sending), with testing and iteration based on real results.

Hands-on deliverability experience: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, domain reputation, and bounce management.

Hands-on HubSpot experience (strongly preferred) and working knowledge of Clay, Apollo, or an equivalent prospecting/enrichment platform.

Strong segmentation, experimentation, cohort analysis, and funnel-measurement skills.

Demonstrated use of AI tools or agents for research, personalization, or campaign execution in a real workflow.

Persuasive, natural copywriting for North American audiences, tested against real response data.

Advanced / professional working proficiency in English.

Nice To Have

Experience recruiting or marketing to students, universities, Gen Z audiences, education, travel, or nonprofit programs.

Experience building cross-stage journeys (e.g., prospect to participant to alumni) or referral/advocacy programs.

Experience with WhatsApp/SMS, multichannel CRM, and working across North America and LATAM teams.

What do we offer you?

Full-time, 100% remote position for candidates based in Latin America, Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (GMT-5).

Competitive salary commensurate with the role, a competitive benefits package, and your birthday off.

End-to-end ownership of outbound and lifecycle growth, with a growth path to a Lead role as the team expands.

Mission-driven work that directly supports MEDLIFE's ability to serve more students and communities.

Position Overview

Are you a life-long learner, curious about the world around you?

Are you passionate about inclusion and the profound impact of global learning?

Are you ready to bring your unique skills to a mission-driven organization?

If so, we would love to welcome you to our global community as a Marketing Technology Administrator !

The Marketing Technology Administrator will own the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and health of our marketing technology stack. HubSpot is our primary platform and will be the center of gravity for this role— roughly half your time will be spent inside it. The rest will be spread across our CMS, analytics, Salesforce sync, and the API connections that tie our systems together.

A major early project will be building multi-touch attribution in HubSpot, mapping the full student journey from lead generation through enrollment so we can see which campaigns drive ROI and where prospects fall off along the way. That work will shape how the company measures marketing’s contribution to enrollment.

You’ll be the person who builds workflows, fixes forms, cleans CRM data, manages permissions, and keeps the systems talking to each other. Marketing leadership own strategy, roadmap, budget, and vendor selection, but because you’ll be closest to the platforms, we’ll expect your input on what’s working, what isn’t, and what we should consider next.

description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing

Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually

Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.

You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.

This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.

Your Work

Property Positioning and Listings

You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.

You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.

Photography and AI Editing

description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,    

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Suites amplias y confortables, el servicio cinco estrellas de siempre y novedades culinarias que no desilusionarán a nadie.    

  

Obtenga más información sobre Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,   

Sitio del hotel: https://www.fourseasons.com/es/mexico/



Instagram: #fsmexico   

FUNCIONES DEL PUESTO

Ejecución de Marketing y Gestión de Campañas

Apoyar al Director de Relaciones Públicas y Marketing en la ejecución de iniciativas de marketing para todos los restaurantes, bares y experiencias culinarias de la propiedad.

Gestionar la planificación, coordinación y ejecución diaria de campañas de marketing, promociones y activaciones.

Asistir en el desarrollo e implementación de programas promocionales alineados con las necesidades del negocio y las oportunidades estacionales.

Coordinar los cronogramas de marketing y garantizar que todos los entregables de las campañas se completen a tiempo.

Asegurar que los materiales promocionales y recursos de marketing se distribuyan correctamente a través de los canales adecuados.

Relaciones Públicas y Coordinación con Medios

Apoyar la ejecución de iniciativas de relaciones públicas para restaurantes y bares en colaboración con la agencia de relaciones públicas de la propiedad y el Director de Relaciones Públicas y Marketing.

Coordinar visitas de medios, degustaciones, colaboraciones con influencers y oportunidades de prensa.

Asistir en la preparación de materiales de prensa, enfoques editoriales y anuncios relacionados con programas culinarios, ofertas de temporada y nuevos conceptos.

Marketing Digital y Redes Sociales

Gestionar la coordinación diaria de iniciativas de redes sociales y marketing digital para restaurantes y bares.

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la organización de calendarios de contenido y garantizar que los recursos de marketing se entreguen a tiempo para redes sociales, campañas y plataformas digitales.

Asistir al Director de Relaciones Públicas en el desarrollo y coordinación de recursos creativos y materiales para medios pagados, garantizando que se entreguen a tiempo y estén alineados con los cronogramas y requisitos de las plataformas digitales.

Mantener y actualizar todas las plataformas en línea, incluyendo:

Google Business Profile

Yelp

OpenTable

TripAdvisor

Instagram y Facebook

Sitios web independientes de restaurantes como BentoBox

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la coordinación de sesiones fotográficas y el desarrollo de contenido para su uso en redes sociales, sitios web y campañas de marketing.

Operaciones de Marketing y Soporte de Contenidos

Asistir en la creación y distribución de comunicaciones de marketing, incluyendo campañas de correo electrónico y mensajes promocionales.

Apoyar la preparación, revisión y coordinación de menús, materiales de marketing y materiales promocionales en colaboración con el equipo de Operaciones de Alimentos y Bebidas (F&B).

Gestionar cronogramas y logística para sesiones fotográficas y creación de contenido que apoyen las iniciativas continuas de marketing.

Experiencia

Entre 3 y 5 años o más de experiencia en marketing, comunicaciones o relaciones públicas dentro de la industria hotelera, restaurantera o marcas de estilo de vida.

Se prefiere fuertemente experiencia previa en marketing de restaurantes u hospitalidad.

Sólido conocimiento de plataformas de marketing digital, redes sociales y herramientas de gestión de reputación en línea.

Excelentes habilidades de redacción, corrección de estilo y comunicación.

Alta capacidad de organización y habilidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.

Orientación al detalle y comodidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y de ritmo acelerado dentro de la industria de la hospitalidad.

Fuertes habilidades de colaboración con equipos multifuncionales, incluyendo operaciones, gastronomía y marketing.

Habilidad para leer, hablar y escribir en español y en inglés avanzado.    
Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y los estándares de servicio del hotel.    
Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia.   
Aplicar un enfoque ético al resultado de las situaciones.    
Fuertes habilidades interpersonales y de construcción de relaciones.

Y muchos más beneficios específicos de cada propiedad y ubicación  

   

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:   

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO desde 1998 entre las "100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Es responsable de contribuir a la conexión del negocio con profesionales de la salud mediante el

title: Social Media Manager (Beauty Market)
skills: Manage social calendar across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, balancing planned product campaigns with reactive cultural moments.

Translate personal care & skincare science into engaging social content, developing educational and routine-based formats (GRWM, de-influencing toxic trends, body-care routines, ingredient spotlights).
Write and adapt social copy tailored to beauty audiences, ensuring empathetic, body-positive, and scientifically grounded tone of voice resonates across each platform.

Ensure all content adheres to Real Beauty pledge (zero digital distortion, real skin textures, diverse representations of beauty and bodies) and meets platform accessibility standards (captions, alt text).
Partner with the Senior Social Media Manager to plan product launches, seasonal moments (e.g., summer body care, self-esteem initiatives), and always-on content.
Monitor channels daily, actively engaging with consumers asking about routines, skin/hair types, product benefits, and self-care tips.
Moderate sensitive beauty conversations with empathy, discretion, and care (e.g., skin insecurities, body image, sweat/odor concerns, hair discrimination).

Track and intercept beauty and wellness micro-trends (e.g., "skin barrier health", "underarm care", "body neutrality"), spotting opportunities for reactive, authentic brand responses before trends peak.
Foster a safe, inclusive community environment that celebrates real bodies, unretouched skin, and everyday beauty rituals.

Collaborate with beauty creators, dermatologists, and lifestyle influencers, ensuring briefs emphasize genuine product testing, authentic reviews, and real-life usage rather than scripted endorsements.
Support the integration of creator/UGC content into the daily publishing grid, ensuring tone, disclosure, and brand beauty standards are fully met.
Coordinate with internal creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce visually compelling assets that show real personal care in action.
Track and analyze performance across platforms, with a focus on metrics that matter in the beauty category: saves (routine reference), shares, comment sentiment, and video completion rates.
Benchmark performance against direct personal care and beauty competitors in Mexico/LATAM.
Extract consumer insights from comments and trends to inform future product storytelling and creative iterations.
Proven experience managing social media for consumer brands, with mandatory experience in Beauty, Personal Care, Cosmetics, or Skincare.

Deep personal care literacy: Familiarity with routine-based content, common personal care ingredients/claims (hydration, microbiome, sulfates, exfoliation), and personal care consumer habits in Mexico.
Strong native fluency across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, knowing what makes beauty/self-care content feel organic, relatable, and scroll-stopping.
Empathetic copywriting skills capable of addressing personal care topics with warmth, authority, and body-inclusive nuance.
Proven track record in community management within high-volume consumer brands, especially navigating body positivity, personal hygiene, and self-esteem conversations.
Proficiency in social media management and social listening tools (e.g., Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Hootsuite) and native analytics.
A natural eye for inclusive casting, unretouched visual aesthetics, and authentic beauty representation.
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish (writing and speaking).

Practical experience using Gen AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney for moodboarding, Copy.ai) to accelerate beauty trend research, caption drafting, and routine brainstorms—always applying human discernment to keep outputs authentic to Dove's voice.
Strong agentic mindset: self-starter attitude, resourceful problem-solving, and the ability to steer personal care narratives autonomously within a busy workflow.
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Advertising, or related fields.
Must reside in Mexico City or Metropolitan Area (Hybrid setup).
Mid-to-Advanced English level (written and spoken).
Solid portfolio/track record demonstrating successful campaigns or social growth in beauty/personal care.
Direct prior experience working on personal care/dermocosmetics brands.
Experience working alongside beauty content creators, nano/micro-influencers, or beauty PR agencies.
Understanding of local cosmetic advertising regulations and claim guidelines (e.g., COFEPRIS nuances in Mexico) regarding personal care.
Experience in social listening around consumer skin/body care concerns and sentiment analysis.
Background in editorial beauty journalism or digital lifestyle magazines.

Colaboramos con más de 300 clientes en más de 40 países y seguimos sumando. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impacten profundamente en las audiencias.

Como parte de Brandtech Group,  estamos a la vanguardia en el uso de tecnología de inteligencia artificial  para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y entregamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de inteligencia artificial mejoran la eficiencia, estimulan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

This is an opportunity to join U-Studio, OLIVER’s award-winning in-house agency for Unilever based in Mexico City with a hybrid working arrangement. You'll be the pulse behind the Brand social presence—one of the world’s most iconic and purposeful personal care brands. From daily skincare and body care conversations, beauty trend tracking, and native content ideation to community care, copy crafting, and performance reporting, you will manage the daily rhythm of Dove's social channels to champion Real Beauty and authentic care across platforms.

This role is built for a social-first beauty enthusiast who is organized, culturally fluent, and obsessed with the evolving personal care landscape. You live and breathe beauty culture on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube; you know the difference between superficial aesthetics and authentic care routines; and you can translate product benefits into relatable, empowering content. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a fast-paced personal care content calendar as they are briefing a diverse beauty creator on an emerging trend or steering sensitive community conversations around body confidence.

Success means channels that set the benchmark for inclusive beauty, content that drives authentic product love, a community that feels safe and represented, and metrics that show consistent growth in engagement, saves, and brand affinity.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Have you built something with AI that changed how your team works? Maybe it's an agentic workflow that runs a process from start to finish, or an automation that fixed an operational problem nobody else could solve. We're looking for a senior builder who already works this way and is ready to do it at scale. You'll own projects in our AI-native knowledge framework. You'll work with subject matter experts and peers to create customer documentation and to design the systems that produce it. Experience in technical writing or content development helps, but your track record of building with AI matters most.



You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 

Learn more about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

Design and build AI-powered workflows that change how we create, review, and maintain knowledge content. Examples include agentic pipelines that draft articles from product release information, or automations that flag outdated content.
Find operational problems across the knowledge program and solve them with AI, from intake and routing to quality checks and SME review.
Own projects on the content operations roadmap from scoping through delivery, including timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder updates.
Set and improve the processes and standards the team uses to develop knowledge, and make sure they work well with our AI tools.
Track KPIs on how well our knowledge content performs, share what you learn, and use the data to decide what to build or fix next.
Work with subject matter experts and peers to create and maintain accurate customer documentation.

Minimum requirements for this role:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
6+ years of professional experience in operations, program management, knowledge management, technical writing, content development, learning and development, or a related field
Hands-on experience building AI solutions to operational problems, such as agentic workflows, multi-step automations, or AI tools connected to other systems. You can walk us through what you built, why you built it, and what changed as a result
Experience owning projects from start to finish, including scoping, timelines, dependencies, and coordination across teams
Experience creating or maintaining technical content, such as documentation, training materials, or knowledge base articles
A track record of spotting problems and solving them without detailed direction
Clear communication with cross-functional partners and stakeholders at every level

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience connecting AI tools to other systems through APIs, automation platforms, or MCP servers
Experience structuring content so AI systems can retrieve and use it accurately
Proficiency in Jira and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Experience with Confluence and Zendesk, or similar knowledge and support platforms
Experience querying data and building dashboards, ideally in Databricks or with SQL
A background in knowledge management or technical writing
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Why YouShift exists

YouShift automates clinical scheduling end-to-end. Admins configure their group's rules once (coverage requirements, fairness constraints, physician contracts, time-off policies) and our engine generates optimized schedules in minutes instead of the days it takes manually. Clinicians submit shift preferences and time-off requests through the app, swap shifts with each other directly, and get visibility into their schedules in real time.

We're now expanding into labor cost intelligence, giving health system leaders direct line of sight into what their workforce is actually costing them, where the leaks are (locums, overtime, unfilled shifts), and how to fix them. Our customers are clinical leaders (CMOs, COOs, VPs of Workforce) and they're trusting us with one of their hardest operational problems.

The role

description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

The Role

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mexico for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you’ll do

You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You’ll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.

What you’ll do


Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements


What you’ll bring

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:


Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs
Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live
Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution


Helpful Experience


Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus
Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued


Success Measures


In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing
In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently


About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

2. Liderazgo Operativo y Consultoría en Seguridad  Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR): Diseñar y presentar las revisiones trimestrales de negocio ante los comités de los clientes, traduciendo métricas operativas en valor financiero y reducción de riesgos para el cliente. title: HubSpot RevOps Specialist
description:
About Us

MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America and Africa to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development projects. Our mission is to build a worldwide Movement empowering the poor in their fight for equal access to healthcare, education, and a safe home. Our vision is a world free from the constraints of poverty. MEDLIFE works with students from around the world in order to broaden their perspectives and better equip them to advocate for social justice.

Our Ideal HubSpot RevOps Specialist

We're looking for someone who has made HubSpot and Revenue Architecture their career and genuinely enjoys it. You've implemented or restructured HubSpot, you know the platform well, and you don't just execute requests: you ask "what is the goal?" and turn the answer into the right configuration. You're comfortable leading working sessions with Marketing and Sales, training teams and explaining technical decisions in simple terms, in Spanish and English. As we continue growing, we'd love for you to be part of the MEDLIFE Movement.

About The Role

You will design and execute the HubSpot Revenue Architecture for our commercial team (Marketing, Ads, Setters and Expansion). You will own the whole implementation in HubSpot, from day one, with the goal of leaving our data centralized, our weekly reporting automated and our teams actively using the tool. You will be part of our RevOps team, which defines and validates the processes, work with our Technology team, and report to Renato Egoavil, our Integrator. This is a full-time, remote role open to candidates based in Latin America.

What will your day-to-day look like at MEDLIFE?:

Diagnose our current HubSpot setup from the end-to-end process map and present a phased roadmap.

Deliver quick wins in your first four weeks: clean up source properties, stop duplicates, set required fields and get basic reports ready.

Unify CRM objects and configure our Setters, Expansion and nurturing pipelines, with standardized stages, exit criteria and loss reasons.

Centralize and normalize data, especially source, attribution and university or company.

Integrate HubSpot with Clay, Alta HQ and Brevo, and review Meta Lead Sync, Google Ads, forms and meeting scheduling.

Build automated weekly reporting: an executive dashboard and team dashboards with conversion by channel and by stage.

Define data governance (data dictionary, owners, quality rules, roles and permissions, change control), train teams and measure adoption every week.

Guide and review the work of a junior HubSpot support profile.

Work in two-week sprints, with a weekly review with RevOps and a demo at the end of each sprint.

What will you bring?:

At least 3 years of CRM experience, including at least 2 years implementing or configuring HubSpot (Marketing and Sales Hub).

Ideally, current HubSpot certifications.

Strong command of objects, properties, workflows and automations, lead scoring, pipelines, attribution and reporting.

Experience with integrations (APIs, Zapier or Make).

Experience in data quality and deduplication.

Understanding of Revenue Operations: lifecycle stages, funnels, attribution and conversion reporting.

The ability to translate business processes into technical configuration.

Bilingual: native or advanced Spanish and upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher.

Based in Latin America and available to work full time.

Nice To Have

Experience mentoring junior profiles.

Knowledge of webhooks or custom code in HubSpot workflows, Operations Hub, data migrations, or tools such as Clay, Alta HQ and Brevo.

What do we offer you?:

Competitive salary commensurate with the role.

Full-time, 100% remote role within Latin America.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm (GMT-5).

Birthday day off.

Competitive benefits package.

Ownership of a full HubSpot implementation from day one, and the possibility of developing a career path within the organization.

Mission-driven work that helps more students and communities join the MEDLIFE Movement.

Please note: We are grateful to all interested candidates, but only those chosen for an interview will be contacted.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano. Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia. Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros. ¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo! ¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2 B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región. Así será tu día a día en Skeelo: Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2 B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas. Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso. Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos. Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas. Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios. Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión. Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas. Para esto, necesitarás: Experiencia previa en Marketing B2 B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos. Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (Hub Spot, RD Station, Asana, Click Up o equivalentes). description:

Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. We're a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LatAm.

Viva’s gearing up for its next growth phase. We need you to build our marketing function from the ground up and improve/accelerate the sustainable pipeline of qualified buyers that drives more revenue.

This is a build-and-lead seat: you’ll set the strategy, get it moving yourself, then hire and coach the team that runs it. If getting into the weeds makes you excited, this is your seat. If being a player-coach does not excite you, or being the player until you hire the team to coach, this is not the role for you.




What you’ll do

Two numbers you'll be measured on: Inbound calls booked and Inbound closed-won deals.

Define and lead marketing strategy. Decide where we place our next bets and where we don’t: focus, channel mix, budget allocation, quarterly rocks. ← This is the 1st problem you'll own.
Execute the strategy. Once you build the plan and identify the processes, tools, and support needed, make it happen and use results to decide what to improve next. ← This is the 2nd problem you’ll own.

Drive cross-functional alignment. Work with both Co-CEOs and leaders across Sales, Customer Success, People, and RevOps to keep priorities aligned, keep HubSpot lead reporting accurate, and diagnose funnel issues together.




Who you are

You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.
You’ve owned SEO end to end and scaled it from 1 to N, and have worked with AEO/GEO. You’ve also built other channels such as events or paid ads from 0 to 1.
You’ve hired, coached, and developed marketing teams, and managed external vendors and agencies.
You’ve generated qualified pipeline for B2B companies with $100K+ ACV.
You’ve marketed to US executive buyers, ideally C-suite, VP, or Head-level, at tech companies from scale-ups to enterprise.
Executive-level English (C1+). You keep up in fast-paced conversations with executives, clearly explain your decisions and the reasoning behind them, and negotiate trade-offs and how plans move forward.




Why you’ll want this

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.
Comprehensive global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. description:

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to lead Sarelly's U.S. marketing. You will own the U.S. brand plan and all U.S. content, turn the plan into campaigns, launches and cultural moments people talk about, and make sure the budget goes where it drives growth.This is a full-time role based in Mexico, with working hours that overlap U.S. time zones. What you'll do




Brand management

Own the annual U.S. brand plan and adjust it every quarter based on results and priorities.
Own all ATL campaigns, from strategy and creative direction to launch and performance.
Own and be responsible for all content developed in the U.S., working with the Mexico team that creates global, brand-led content.

Keep the brand consistent across the U.S. and Mexico.




Activations and performance

Own all BTL campaigns, including retail activations and in-store moments, that drive sales.
Manage performance marketing and creative agencies and partners, so our content does not just look good but performs.
Drive daily TikTok content that grows awareness, builds consumer engagement and drives people to shop.
Read results, decide what to scale and what to stop, and shift spend accordingly.
Manage the marketing budget across the different teams.




Channel support

Support the marketing plans for all our channels: direct-to-consumer, Amazon, TikTok and Target.
Collaborate with the appropriate teams across the organization, in the U.S. and Mexico.




PR and events

Own the U.S. PR plan and work with PR partners to build brand awareness and press visibility.
Lead online and in-person activations around the key cultural moments Sarelly plays in.
Plan and run brand, press and creator events that bring Sarelly to life for consumers.




Budget management

Own and track A&P budget including proposing optimizations at a quarterly basis
Lead team marketing tracking to ensure budget and spend coincide




Leadership and team

Lead, coach and develop a Junior Brand Manager and a Marketing Assistant.
Set clear goals and priorities for the team and hold it to a high standard of execution.
Represent U.S. marketing with leadership and the Mexico teams.




What we're looking for

5+ years in beauty, CPG or social-first brand marketing, including U.S. market experience, and at least 2 years leading people and in the beauty industry.
A track record of running annual brand plans, integrated ATL and BTL campaigns and product launches.
Experience owning a marketing budget and linking spend to business results.
Strong content judgment: you know what converts, not just what looks good.
Hands-on experience with social-first content, creators and affiliate programs, with a record of growing awareness and engagement and driving sales.
Analytical: you read performance data and act on it.
Fluent English and Spanish, with excellent presentation skills.
Comfortable leading in a fast-moving, early-stage, Flexible work environment.

Retail and trade marketing experience
Experience launching or scaling a brand in a new market, or insight into U.S. Latina and Hispanic consumers.

Job Title: Director of Marketing COMPANY BACKGROUND

Black Dragon Capital LLC (BDC) is a unique growth-oriented private equity firm focused on investing in areas where information technology is enabling the disruption of industries by allowing a faster, better and more economically compelling way to solve industry issues.

We seek to benefit from a diverse perspective combined with high performance operating and investment executives.

We hire and promote based on merit, without bias, and make a genuine effort to ensure we have a diversified team that aligns with the diversity of our portfolio companies and their clients.

We intend to maintain over 65% of our team members as culturally or gender diverse and work hard to foster a supportive and welcoming workplace.

Bringing a leadership and advisory group of successful entrepreneurs, former operators and deal making experience, Black Dragon’s team has a track record of building market leading companies, driving above market returns and accelerating growth and profitability through its distribution connections, strategic advice, and active participation within our investments, primarily in financial technologies, eCommerce, and sports and media technology markets.

Role Overview

Reporting to the COO – Dragon Performance Group, the Director of Marketing will be a visionary leader responsible for creating and executing the overarching marketing strategy for the firm and its portfolio companies.

This senior leadership position requires a dynamic and adaptable individual who can seamlessly integrate marketing strategies into the business model of a private equity firm while supporting growth objectives across multiple industries.

The ideal candidate will be innovative, resilient, and able to thrive in fast paced, high-pressure environments.

Experience at the highest levels of the Financial Services industry, with additional expertise in the Broadcast Media sector, as well as working knowledge of B2C marketing, will be a significant advantage.

The Director of Marketing will also be responsible for overseeing a growing global team, managing key marketing functions, and ensuring consistent brand messaging and risk mitigation strategies across all communications.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision:

Work closely with executive leadership, investment teams and portfolio leaders, to align marketing strategies with business objectives.

Serve as a trusted advisor to portfolio companies, guiding them in marketing best practices, brand development, and market expansion.

Support the marketing strategy for the founder’s non-profit, Foundation for A Bright Future

Lead and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and resilience within the marketing team.

Event Management

Oversee boutique, medium and large-scale event planning and execution, including conferences, investor meetings, and industry-specific events, to promote the firm and portfolio companies.

Manage public relations efforts to build the firm’s brand reputation, leveraging media relationships, strategic partnerships, and crisis communication tactics.

Brand Management & Social Media

Develop and oversee the brand strategy for the firm and its portfolio companies, ensuring consistent messaging and visual identity.

Promote Black Dragon as a unique, next generation approach to Private Equity and as the preeminent PE firm in our primary sectors.

Additionally, preserving and positioning the firm’s executives and partners as thought leaders in these spaces.

Direct social media strategy to increase engagement, reach key stakeholders, and create compelling content that supports business goals.

PR Strategy & Risk Mitigation

Manage public relations efforts to build the firm’s brand reputation, leveraging media relationships, strategic partnerships, and crisis communication tactics.

Proactively identify and address potential risks related to brand reputation and marketing campaigns.

Performance Analytics & Reporting

Monitor, analyze, and report on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, adjusting strategies as needed to optimize results and ROI.

Use data-driven insights to refine and improve marketing approaches across all channels.

Qualifications Required

A minimum of 10-15 years of experience in marketing, with at least 5 years in senior leadership positions within the Financial Services Industry; experience in Broadcast Media is a plus.

B2C experience also a plus.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree a plus.

Demonstrated success in event management, PR, social media strategy, and brand development at a corporate level.

Strong leadership abilities with experience managing cross-functional remote teams and driving performance across diverse groups.

Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the flexibility to pivot when needed.

Location: Remote.

Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?





We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 










Run and own the channel




You will own the Ecommerce D2C P&L for Chile as its commercial result. You will set the plan to hit the number and run the channel strategy, working from inside the country team identifying growth opportunities. 




Emma has sold mattresses to 12M+ sleepers in 35+ countries, backed by a 10-year guarantee and a 100-night trial. You’ll lead the next stage of that growth in Chile.

You’ll align Operations (S&OP, Customer Experience, Logistics), Marketing, Finance and the Webshop team around the channel’s business growth goals. You’ll make independent calls on promotions, discounts within guardrails, product prioritization and bundles. You’ll also strengthen the regional BD network. That means documenting best practice, acting as sparring partner between market and region, and leading cross-market initiatives.

Description

Do you want to drive product strategy for Amazon's last mile delivery network across Latin America? Are you looking for a high-impact role where you can combine global best practices with regional innovation to shape the future of delivery in one of Amazon's fastest-growing markets? The Global Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Organization is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own the DSP product strategy and offer roadmap for Latin America (LATAM).

At Amazon, we're constantly reinventing the customer experience, including how we fulfill and deliver orders. A key part of this is our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program, which empowers small businesses to build their own delivery companies using Amazon's proven logistics technology and processes. These DSP partners form the backbone of our last mile delivery network across 20+ international geographies, allowing us to provide a fast, reliable, and cost-effective delivery experience for our customers. In Latin America, we face a uniquely dynamic environment—a competitive ecommerce landscape, rapidly evolving last mile delivery models, and enormous growth potential that demands dedicated product leadership to unlock.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end DSP product strategy and roadmap for LATAM, serving as the primary bridge between the Global Offer organization and regional stakeholders. You will embed closely with local MX and BR teams to understand regional priorities, develop product solutions that address critical business challenges, and ensure global best practices are adapted and deployed in LATAM—while amplifying successful regional innovations globally. Depending on the candidates location, domestic and international travel to LATAM will be required up to 20% of the time.

We Are Open To Candidates Based Out Of

Mexico City, MEX

Sao Paulo, BR

Bellevue, WA, USA

Key job responsibilities

Own the LATAM DSP product strategy and roadmap for Mexico and Brazil, ensuring alignment between Global Offer standards and regional business priorities

Conduct semi-annual LATAM Roadmap Reviews to ensure Global Offer support responds to shifts in regional priorities and maintain alignment on upcoming initiatives

Serve as the regional voice within the Global Offer org, translating local needs into global product requirements and advocating for LATAM priorities in resource allocation and planning

Build and manage relationships with local operations, finance, legal, and program teams in MX and BR to ensure tight feedback loops and rapid iteration

Author offer documents, product reviews, and business cases with bottoms-up financial justification, sensitivity analysis, and CPP comparison to next best alternatives

Communicate product strategies and recommendations effectively to senior leadership, driving critical business decisions in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Zenit Corp

Zenit Corp is a fast growing ecommerce group that owns and operates multiple DTC brands across different markets.

We are building a portfolio of high potential ecommerce brands with strong fundamentals, scalable systems, and ambitious long term growth plans. Our goal is to create a multi brand ecommerce group capable of reaching significant scale across different verticals.

The company is currently in a high growth stage and this creates a unique opportunity for people joining now to take ownership, grow with the company, and help shape the next stage of the group.

This is an opportunity to join early, take ownership, create impact, and help build the creative strategy function of a group with ambitious long term goals.




Role

The Creative Strategist is responsible for connecting marketing performance with creative execution. This person turns research, data, customer psychology, and business priorities into clear creative direction for paid social, landing pages, campaign concepts, and content tests.

This role is not limited to coming up with ideas. The Creative Strategist is responsible for building a structured creative process, identifying winning angles, writing strong creative briefs, analyzing what is working, and helping the team produce ads designed to perform.

This person works directly with the Head Of Marketing and marketing team, and collaborates with media buyers, designers, editors, copywriters, and creators to make sure creative output is aligned with growth objectives.

The role is expected to bring taste, structure, speed, and performance oriented thinking to a growing ecommerce group.




Creative Strategist Responsibilities




❖ Creative Strategy & Research

➢ Research customers, competitors, market trends, ad libraries, reviews, comments, and social platforms to identify strong creative opportunities.

➢ Translate customer motivations, objections, desires, and buying triggers into creative angles, hooks, messages, and offers.

➢ Build a clear understanding of each brand’s positioning and customer psychology.

➢ Stay close to what is working across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.




❖ Ad Concepts, Hooks & Creative Briefs

➢ Develop new ad concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, UGC directions, landing page ideas, and campaign angles.

➢ Write clear creative briefs that explain the objective, target customer, key message, structure, examples, and success criteria.

➢ Create both quick iterations and bigger creative tests that can help unlock new performance.

➢ Maintain an organized backlog of creative tests, angles, and hypotheses for each brand.




❖ Performance Analysis & Creative Testing

➢ Analyze creative performance with the marketing team to understand what drives clicks, conversions, CPA, ROAS, retention, and scale.

➢ Identify patterns in winning and losing creatives and turn those patterns into new tests.

➢ Help define creative testing roadmaps and prioritize the ideas most likely to improve performance.

➢ Create feedback loops between performance results and future creative production.




❖ Collaboration With Creative Production

➢ Work closely with designers, editors, copywriters, media buyers, creators, and other team members to turn ideas into finished assets.

➢ Give clear, practical, and constructive feedback on creative work.

➢ Make sure creative assets are aligned with the brief, the brand, the customer insight, and the performance goal.

➢ Build repeatable frameworks, references, and standards that help the team produce better creative over time.




❖ Brand, Customer & Market Understanding

➢ Protect each brand’s positioning while still pushing for strong direct response performance.

➢ Use customer language to improve ads, landing pages, hooks, and messages.

➢ Identify new angles based on customer objections, product benefits, competitive gaps, and market shifts.

➢ Help the company build a stronger creative foundation as the group grows.




What This Role Is Not

➢ This role is not a traditional Creative Director role focused only on visual taste or brand aesthetics.

➢ This role is not a graphic designer, video editor, or content creator role, although it works closely with those functions.

➢ This role is not responsible for managing ad spend or making final media buying decisions alone.

➢ This role is not a pure social media management or community management role.

➢ This role is not responsible for defining company strategy on its own.

➢ This role is not about producing random ideas without research, structure, testing, or performance accountability.




The Creative Strategist owns creative research, angles, briefs, testing direction, performance learning, and creative feedback loops. The Head Of Marketing and marketing leadership own final business priorities, budgets, and strategic decisions.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Associate, Data Analytics and BI who will:


Develop, update, and maintain highly interactive dashboards and visualizations, ensuring they are accurate, visually impactful, and architecturally sound.

Coordinate project timelines and deliverable schedules, proactively communicating progress, risks, and dependencies. 
Adapt to changing business needs by supporting different onshore agency teams and coordinating team support when needed. 
Identify and optimize repetitive tasks, improving reporting efficiency and operational consistency. 
Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation of workflows, data schemas, QA testing processes, and change logs. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


5+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Data QA, preferably within a digital marketing agency, media agency, or commerce media environment. 
Advanced, hands-on expertise in Power BI; experience with Datorama, Tableau, or Looker is highly valued. 
Advanced Excel proficiency. 
Proven understanding of software QA methodologies, test-case planning, and automated testing frameworks applied to data pipelines. 
Deep familiarity with ad-tech and digital platforms, such as Google Campaign Manager, social platforms, and DSPs, as well as web analytics tools. 
Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within an onshore/offshore operating model. 
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
Proficiency in SQL, Python, or ETL scripting is a plus. 
Exposure to cloud infrastructure is a plus, preferably Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow, or equivalent AWS/Azure services. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.
