description:
About Influur

Influur is reimagining how advertising works through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid media, and we're building the tech that makes it possible. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we're scaling fast across music, culture, and entertainment.

We're looking for an Outreach Specialist who's excited to combine influencer marketing, AI, and data to help us discover new creators, build meaningful relationships, and scale our outreach efforts.

You'll work at the intersection of creator discovery, influencer outreach, and AI-powered automation, helping us identify the right talent for our campaigns, improve response rates, and build smarter, more efficient processes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the creator economy, enjoys experimenting with technology, and is constantly thinking about how to make things better.

What You'll Do

Creator Discovery & Outreach

Identify, research, and connect with influencers who align with our clients' needs, campaign objectives, and target audiences.

Proactive Creator Pipeline Building

Anticipate recurring campaign needs and proactively build pipelines of relevant creators, ensuring our teams have fresh talent available for upcoming opportunities.

Influencer Research & Evaluation

Analyze creator profiles using relevant metrics such as engagement rates, audience demographics, content quality, and brand alignment.

AI-Powered Outreach

Leverage AI tools and automation to streamline creator discovery, personalize communications, and scale outreach efforts without losing the human touch.

Outreach Performance & Optimization

Monitor outreach metrics, including response rates, creator interest, and conversion trends, to identify opportunities for improvement.

Creator Communication

Manage influencer conversations across email, social media, and other outreach channels, maintaining authentic, personalized, and professional communication.

AI & Process Improvement

Collaborate with our engineering and internal teams to improve existing AI agents, develop new automation workflows, and optimize outreach processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Campaign Management and List Building teams to understand upcoming campaign needs and ensure a consistent pipeline of relevant creators.

Experimentation & Growth

Proactively test new outreach strategies, messaging approaches, and AI-powered solutions to improve efficiency, creator engagement, and overall results.

Your Skillset

Must-Haves

Experience or strong familiarity with influencer marketing, creator outreach, campaign coordination, or talent sourcing.

Solid understanding of the creator economy, social media platforms, and what makes an influencer a good fit for a brand or campaign.

Ability to evaluate influencer profiles using basic performance metrics, including engagement, audience relevance, and content quality.

Strong interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with the ability to learn and experiment with new tools.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, tracking outreach activities, and interpreting basic performance data to identify trends and opportunities.

Fluent in English and Spanish (written and spoken), with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage naturally and professionally with creators across different markets.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple creator conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously.

Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to independently identify opportunities for improvement.

Nice-to-Haves

Previous experience working at an influencer marketing agency, creator management company, or influencer marketing platform.

Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or AI-powered automation platforms.

Experience building or improving automated outreach workflows using tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with influencer discovery and analytics tools.

Experience tracking outreach performance, analyzing response rates, or optimizing creator acquisition strategies.

Exposure to influencer negotiations, rate discussions, or creator relationship management.

Experience collaborating with technical or engineering teams on automation projects.

Background in a fast-growing startup or technology-driven environment.

You're the Type Who

You're an AI-first thinker.

You're genuinely excited about AI and constantly exploring how technology can help you work smarter, automate repetitive tasks, and create better processes.

You're proactive by nature.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You identify opportunities, anticipate needs, and take initiative to move things forward.

You think in numbers.

You enjoy understanding what the data is telling you, identifying patterns, and finding ways to improve performance.

You're a builder.

You love experimenting, testing new ideas, and improving existing workflows. If something can be done better, you'll find a way.

You understand creators.

You know that behind every influencer profile is a real person, and you believe that even AI-powered outreach should feel personal, authentic, and human.

You're resourceful.

You can figure things out independently, learn new tools quickly, and find creative solutions when things don't go as planned.

You thrive in fast-paced environments.

You're comfortable with changing priorities, evolving processes, and the ambiguity that comes with building something new.

You take ownership.

You're organized, reliable, and accountable for your results. You follow through and make sure things get done.

You're always looking ahead.

You don't just focus on today's outreach. You're constantly thinking about what creators, strategies, and opportunities we'll need next.

title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
skills: Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.
You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.
Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.
Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.
Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.
Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.
